verdicts.title: Finite unitary ring with minimal non-nilpotent group of units
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $R$ be a finite unitary ring such that $R=R_0[R^*]$ where $R_0$ is the prime ring and $R^*$ is not a nilpotent group. We show that if all proper subgroups of $R^*$ are nilpotent groups, then the cardinal of $R$ is a power of prime number 2. In addition, if $(R/Jac(R))^*$ is not a $p-$group, then either $R\cong M_2(GF(2))$ or $R\cong M_2(GF(2))\oplus A$ where $M_2(GF(2))$ is the ring of $2\times 2$ matrices over the finite field $GF(2)$ and $A$ is a direct sum of finite field $GF(2)$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns finite unitary rings whose unit groups are minimal non-nilpotent, mentioning GF(2) only as a coefficient field for matrix rings; it says nothing about Grothendieck-Witt classes, boolean functions, or communication complexity rank.

verdicts.title: Knock-Knock: Black-Box, Platform-Agnostic DRAM Address-Mapping Reverse Engineering
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Modern Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) employ undocumented linear address-scrambling functions to obfuscate DRAM addressing, which complicates DRAM-aware performance optimizations and hinders proactive security analysis of DRAM-based attacks; most notably, Rowhammer. verdicts.title: Generalized Fourier coefficients of multiplicative functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We introduce and analyse a general class of not necessarily bounded multiplicative functions, examples of which include the function $n \mapsto δ^{ω(n)}$, where $δ\neq 0$ and where $ω$ counts the number of distinct prime factors of $n$, as well as the function $n \mapsto |λ_f(n)|$, where $λ_f(n)$ denotes the Fourier coefficients of a primitive holomorphic cusp form.
